identity.title: [CI][WP-02A regression] Do not launch optional workspace coverage producers

values.task_boundary: Fix issue #13 only: explicit coverage-producer selection, aggregation, and focused regression proof.
deliverables: Explicit Runtime, fast-workspace, and full-workspace producer selectors.
Job-level producer guards and deterministic aggregate result checks.
Retained CI timing evidence from the reviewable PR run.
acceptance_criteria: A Runtime-local change does not execute either full-workspace shard.
Producer routing occurs at job level before checkout and tool installation.
The required adl-coverage check succeeds for intentionally skipped workspace coverage.
Full workspace coverage runs when selected.
Focused contracts cover selected and unselected producer and aggregator combinations.
CI evidence shows unselected producers consume only GitHub skipped-job accounting.
